sanskrit: pra somāsaḥ svādhyaḥ pavamānāso akramuḥ | rayiṁ kṛṇvanti cetanam ||
english: The Soma juices, self-bright and purifying, have flowed forth; they create wealth endowed with consciousness.

sanskrit: divas pṛthivyā adhi bhavendo dyumnavarddhanaḥ | bhavā vājānām patiḥ ||
english: Be, O Indu, above heaven and earth, increaser of splendour; be the lord of nourishing powers.

sanskrit: tubhyaṁ vātā abhipriya stubhyam arṣanti sindhavaḥ | soma vardhanti te mahaḥ ||
english: To you, O Soma, the winds blow most dear; to you the rivers stream; they increase your greatness.

sanskrit: ā pyāyasva sam etu te viśvataḥ soma vṛṣṇyam | bhavā vājasya saṁgathe ||
english: Swell forth; let your virile power come together to you from all sides, O Soma; be present at the gathering of nourishment.

sanskrit: tubhyaṁ gāvo ghṛtam payo babhro duduhrṣ akṣitam | varṣiṣṭhe adhi sānavi ||
english: To you, O tawny one, the cows have milked butter and indestructible milk upon the highest ridge.

sanskrit: svāyudhasya te sato bhuvanasya pate vayam | indo sakhi tvam uśmasi ||
english: O Indu, lord of the world, you who are well-armed and ever-present — we desire your friendship.

sanskrit: pra somāso madacyutaḥ śravase no maghonaḥ | sutā vidathe akramuḥ ||
english: The Soma juices, dripping with exhilaration, have flowed forth for our glory, for us the bountiful; the pressed drops have advanced to the assembly.

sanskrit: ād īṁ tritasya yoṣaṇo hariṁ hinvanty adribhiḥ | indum indrāya pītaye ||
english: The maidens of Trita press the tawny one forward with the pressing-stones — the Indu for Indra to drink.

sanskrit: ād īṁ haṁso yathā gaṇaṁ viśvasyāvīvaśan matim | atyo na gobhir ajyate ||
english: Like a swan upon the flock, he has filled all minds with desire; like a swift steed he is anointed with the milk-streams.

sanskrit: ubhe somāvacākaśan mṛgo na takto arṣasi | sīdann ṛtasya yonim ā ||
english: You have illumined both worlds, O Soma; like a beast that has been sprinkled, you flow onward, settling into the womb of Ṛta.

sanskrit: abhi gāvo anūṣata yoṣā jāram iva priyam | agann ājiṁ yathā hitam ||
english: The cows have lowed in response, as a young woman toward her beloved lover; they have reached the contest as if appointed.

sanskrit: asme dhehi dyumad yaśo magha vadbhyaś ca mahyam ca | sanim medhām uta śravaḥ ||
english: Bestow upon us and upon the bountiful ones luminous glory, O Soma; bestow the winning of wisdom and of fame.

sanskrit: pra somāso vipaścito 'pāṁ na yanty ūrmayaḥ | vanāni mahiṣā iva ||
english: The wise Soma juices flow forward like waves of the waters, like buffaloes through forests.

sanskrit: abhi droṇāni babhravaḥ śukrā ṛtasya dhārayā | vājaṁ gomantam akṣaran ||
english: The tawny, bright ones have streamed into the wooden vessels with the stream of Ṛta, carrying nourishment rich in cattle.

sanskrit: sutā indrāya vāyave varuṇāya marudbhyaḥ | somā arṣanti viṣṇave ||
english: The pressed Soma juices flow for Indra, for Vāyu, for Varuṇa, for the Maruts, and for Viṣṇu.

sanskrit: tisro vāca ud īrate gāvo mimanti dhenavaḥ | harir eti kanikridat ||
english: Three voices arise; the cows low, the milch-cows cry; the tawny Soma comes roaring along.

sanskrit: abhi brahmīr anūṣata yahvīr ṛtasya mātaraḥ | marmṛjyante divaḥ śiśum ||
english: The sacred prayer-streams have sounded in answer, the mighty mothers of Ṛta; they cleanse the child of heaven.

sanskrit: rāyaḥ samudrām̐ś caturo 'smabhyaṁ soma viśvataḥ | ā pavasva sahasriṇaḥ ||
english: Purify for us, O Soma, from every side the four oceans of wealth, thousandfold.

sanskrit: pra suvāno dhārayā tanendur hinvāno arṣati | rujad dṛḍhā vy ojasā ||
english: Pressed and urged forward, the Indu streams along with a continuous flow, breaking through firm obstacles with his might.

sanskrit: suta indrāya vāyave varuṇāya marudbhyaḥ | somo arṣati viṣṇave ||
english: Pressed out, Soma streams for Indra, for Vāyu, for Varuṇa, for the Maruts, and for Viṣṇu.

sanskrit: vṛṣāṇaṁ vṛṣabhir yataṁ sunvanti somam adribhiḥ | duhanti śakmanā payaḥ ||
english: They press the Soma, the vigorous bull yoked with bull-like stones; with skillful effort they milk forth the milk.

sanskrit: bhuvat tritasya marjyo bhuvad indrāya matsaraḥ | saṁ rūpair ajyate hariḥ ||
english: He becomes the cleanser of Trita; he becomes the exhilarating drink for Indra; the tawny one is anointed with his bright forms.

sanskrit: abhīm ṛtasya viṣṭapaṁ duhate pṛśnimātaraḥ | cāru priyatamaṁ haviḥ ||
english: The speckled mothers milk for him the summit of Ṛta — the dear and most beloved oblation.

sanskrit: sam enam ahrutā imā giro arṣanti sasrutaḥ | dhenūr vāśro avīvaśat ||
english: These faultless hymns flow together toward him as he streams along; the roaring one has called out to the milk-cows.

sanskrit: ā naḥ pavasva dhārayā pavamāna rayim pṛthum | yayā jyotir vidāsi naḥ ||
english: Purify for us, O Pavamāna, with a stream of abundant wealth, whereby you would reveal light to us.

sanskrit: indo samudramīṅkhaya pavasva viśvamejaya | rāyo dhartā na ojasā ||
english: O Indu, set the ocean in motion; flow onward, shaker of all things, sustainer of riches for us by your might.

sanskrit: tvayā vīreṇa vīravo 'bhi ṣyāma pṛtanyataḥ | kṣarā ṇo abhi vāryam ||
english: With you as our hero, O heroic one, may we overcome those who attack us; flow toward us what is desirable.

sanskrit: pra vājam indur iṣyati siṣāsan vājasā ṛṣiḥ | vratā vidāna āyudhā ||
english: The Indu, the inspired sage desiring to win nourishment, sends forward the prize — knowing the sacred ordinances and his weapons.

sanskrit: taṁ gīrbhir vācamīṅkhayam punānaṁ vāsayāmasi | somaṁ janasya gopatim ||
english: Him who sets speech in motion, we clothe with hymns as he purifies himself — Soma, the lord of the people's cattle.

sanskrit: viśvo yasya vrate jano dādhāra dharmaṇas pateḥ | punānasya prabhūvasoḥ ||
english: All people have steadied themselves in the sacred vow of him who is the lord of Dharma, of him who purifies himself, the lord of abundant wealth.

sanskrit: asarji rathyo yathā pavitre camvoḥ sutaḥ | kārṣman vājī ny akramīt ||
english: He has been released like a racehorse; pressed out, he enters the filter of the two bowls; the prize-winning steed has stepped down upon the field.

sanskrit: sa vahniḥ soma jāgṛviḥ pavasva devavīr ati | abhi kośam madhuścutam ||
english: You, O Soma, the ever-wakeful carrier, flow onward, most heroic among the gods, toward the vessel that drips with sweetness.

sanskrit: sa no jyotīṁṣi pūrvya pavamāna vi rocaya | kratve dakṣāya no hinu ||
english: O Pavamāna, you the primeval one, illuminate the lights for us; impel us toward wisdom and discernment.

sanskrit: śumbhamāna ṛtāyubhir mṛjyamāno gabhastyoḥ | pavate vāre avyaye ||
english: Adorning himself with those who live by Ṛta, being cleansed by the hands, he purifies himself in the imperishable wool-filter.

sanskrit: sa viśvā dāśuṣe vasu somo divyāni pārthivā | pavatām āntarikṣyā ||
english: Let that Soma purify all heavenly, earthly, and atmospheric riches for the worshipper.

sanskrit: ā divas pṛṣṭham aśvayur gavyayuḥ soma rohasi | vīrayuḥ śavasas pate ||
english: Desiring horses, desiring cattle, O Soma, desiring heroes — you ascend to the back of heaven, O lord of might.

sanskrit: sa sutaḥ pītaye vṛṣā somaḥ pavitre arṣati | vighnan rakṣāṁsi devayuḥ ||
english: This Soma, pressed and bull-like, streams through the filter for drinking, smiting the demons, eager for the gods.

sanskrit: sa pavitre vicakṣaṇo harir arṣati dharṇasiḥ | abhi yoniṁ kanikridat ||
english: The far-seeing tawny one, the steady one, streams through the filter, roaring toward his birthplace.

sanskrit: sa vājī rocanā divaḥ pavamāno vi dhāvati | rakṣohā vāram avyayam ||
english: The prize-winning Pavamāna runs through the luminous realms of heaven, the slayer of demons, through the imperishable woolen strainer.

sanskrit: sa tritasyādhi sānavi pavamāno arocayat | jāmibhiḥ sūryaṁ saha ||
english: Purifying himself upon the ridge of Trita's realm, he illumined the sun together with his kinsmen.

sanskrit: sa vṛtrahā vṛṣā suto varivo vid adābhyaḥ | somo vājam ivāsarat ||
english: That pressed, bull-like, unfailing Soma, slayer of Vṛtra, the finder of wide space, has rushed forward as if to win the prize.

sanskrit: sa devaḥ kavineṣito 'bhi droṇāni dhāvati | indur indrāya maṁhanā ||
english: That divine one, urged by the sage, runs toward the wooden vessels; the Indu flows toward Indra with his bounty.

sanskrit: eṣa u sya vṛṣā ratho 'vyo vārebhir arṣati | gacchan vājaṁ sahasriṇam ||
english: This indeed is that bull-like chariot which streams with the sheep's-wool strands, going to win the thousandfold prize.

sanskrit: etaṁ tritasya yoṣaṇo hariṁ hinvanty adribhiḥ | indum indrāya pītaye ||
english: The maidens of Trita urge this tawny one forward with the pressing-stones — the Indu for Indra to drink.

sanskrit: etaṁ tyaṁ harito daśa marmṛjyante apasyuvaḥ | yābhir madāya śumbhate ||
english: The ten tawny mares, eager for action, cleanse him — those by whom he shines for the exhilaration.

sanskrit: eṣa sya māṇuṣīṣv ā śyeno na vikṣu sīdati | gacchan jāro na yoṣitam ||
english: This one settles among human settlements like a falcon, going like a lover toward a woman.

sanskrit: eṣa sya madyo raso 'va caṣṭe divaḥ śiśuḥ | ya indur vāram āviśat ||
english: This intoxicating juice, the child of heaven, gazes down, this Indu who has entered the woolen filter.

sanskrit: eṣa sya pītaye suto harir arṣati dharṇasiḥ | krandan yonim abhi priyam ||
english: This pressed tawny one, the steady one, streams for drinking, calling out toward his dear birthplace.

sanskrit: āśur arṣa bṛhanmate pari priyeṇa dhāmnā | yatra devā iti bravan ||
english: Flow swiftly, O Soma, for him of great wisdom, around with your dear abode — where the gods declare you to be.

sanskrit: pariṣkṛṇvann aniṣkṛtaṁ janāya yātayann iṣaḥ | vṛṣṭiṁ divaḥ pari srava ||
english: Adorning what is unadorned, dispensing refreshments to the people, flow around as the rain of heaven.

sanskrit: suta eti pavitra ā tviṣiṁ dadhāna ojasā | vicakṣāṇo virocayan ||
english: The pressed one moves through the filter, bearing brilliance with his might, all-seeing and illumining.

sanskrit: ayaṁ sa yo divas pari rughuyāmā pavitra ā | sindhor ūrmā vy akṣarat ||
english: This is he who, swift of course, has flowed out through the filter from the heavens, like a wave of a river.

sanskrit: āvivāsan parāvato atho arvāvataḥ sutaḥ | indrāya sicyate madhu ||
english: Shining forth from what is far away and also from what is near, the pressed one — the sweet drink is poured for Indra.

sanskrit: samīcīnā anūṣata hariṁ hinvanty adribhiḥ | yonāv ṛtasya sīdata ||
english: Those who face together have sounded in response; they urge the tawny one forward with the pressing-stones; settle in the womb of Ṛta.

sanskrit: punāno akramīd abhi viśvā mṛdho vicarṣaṇiḥ | śumbhanti vipraṁ dhītibhiḥ ||
english: Purifying himself, the all-beholding one has advanced against all enemies; with their sacred thoughts they adorn the inspired sage.

sanskrit: ā yonim aruṇo ruhad gamad indraṁ vṛṣā sutaḥ | dhruve sadasi sīdati ||
english: The ruddy, bull-like, pressed Soma mounts the birthplace; he goes to Indra; he settles in the firm abode.

sanskrit: nū no rayim mahām indo 'smabhyaṁ soma viśvataḥ | ā pavasva sahasriṇam ||
english: Now, O Indu, O Soma, purify for us from every side a great and thousandfold wealth.

sanskrit: viśvā soma pavamāna dyumnānīndav ā bhara | vidāḥ sahasriṇīr iṣaḥ ||
english: O Soma Pavamāna, O Indu, bring to us all glories; bring thousandfold refreshments.

sanskrit: sa naḥ punāna ā bhara rayiṁ stotre suvīryam | jaritur vardhayā giraḥ ||
english: Do you, as you purify yourself, bring to us wealth rich in valiant men for the singer; increase the hymns of the praiser.

sanskrit: punāna indav ā bhara soma dvibарhasaṁ rayim | vṛṣann indo na ukthyam ||
english: O Indu, as you purify yourself, O Soma, bring us doubly-great wealth; O bull, O Indu, bring us what is worthy of praise.
